'''Faalo's Will''' was a [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic lightsaber technique]]. It was named after [[Vo'ren Faalo/Legends|Vo'ren Faalo]], a famous [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] instructor.<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> and was first described in the [[Book of Practical Lightsaber Technique]].<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Faalo's Will">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Faalo's Will}}</ref>
